description: This file defines a PHP interface 'JsonApiResourceIdentifier' within the SuiteCRM project's API namespace. It specifies method signatures for retrieving and setting resource identifiers, including ID and type, used in JSON API representations.

classes.name: JsonApiResourceIdentifier
classes.description: An interface that mandates methods for managing resource identifiers (ID and type) in JSON API context.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID as a string.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the resource ID and returns the resource instance or interface for chaining.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type as a string.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the resource type and returns the resource instance or interface for chaining.
